name: Lac Gold Ltd
summary: Based in West Perth, Australia, Lac Gold Limited is a gold exploration company, operating alongside its subsidiary, across Australia and Canada. A key asset is its wholly-owned Pickle Lake Gold project in Canada. This project, located in the Uchi Geological sub-province of north-western Ontario, is primarily comprised of the Kasagiminnis, Dorothy, and Dobie gold deposits. The company adopted its current name, Lac Gold Limited, in May 2026, having previously been known as Ardiden Limited.
